messages:
maria_cs: Quick check — BrightEdge onboarding doc needs an SLA summary for their CSM and procurement. They flagged uptime SLO 99.9% and p90 latency 450ms for the generate endpoint. Do we have a clear way to show last 30d uptime and p90, plus how credits would be calculated if missed? Need to send by EOD.

sam_eng: Got it, will pull last-30d from the console and drop numbers here. Quick q: are we reporting streaming vs full-response latency separately or just full-response?

nina_re: Recommend we surface full-response p90 for procurement. Also suggest marking this as a provisional onboarding SLO for 30 days — prevents unintended renewal risk if numbers move when they go to dedicated.

aj_sales: Procurement asked for a simple credit formula they can understand. Olivia, can finance confirm the standard calculation we give to customers?

olivia_fin: Confirmed — standard is prorated monthly credit tied to the invoice period, with a cap (legal approved) of up to 50% of monthly bill. We need invoice baseline and the exact metric breach window to compute.

sam_eng: Pulled numbers from the dashboard — last 30d snapshot below. Will attach CSV to the ticket.

sam_eng: ```SLA 30d snapshot:
- uptime: 99.92%
- p90 latency (generate endpoint, full response): 480ms
- p95 latency: 780ms
- incidents: 2 (maintenance window + cache GC bug)
```

maria_cs: Ok — Nina + Olivia, can you draft a 2–3 sentence SLA paragraph for onboarding that includes the provisional clause and the credits calc? I'll paste into the onboarding packet and send to BrightEdge. @sam_eng please attach the console link and the CSV export. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Export complete — /shared/onboarding/sla-snapshots/BrightEdge-1812345678.csv (report job id rj-7821).

nina_re: Drafted paragraph and uploaded to doc: https://docs.internal/brightedge-onboarding-sla (placeholder). Suggested wording: "During the initial 30-day onboarding period, SLO targets are provisional. Measured uptime and latency will be reported weekly; any creditable breaches will be calculated per the credit schedule (prorated monthly credit up to the contractual cap)."

aj_sales: Thanks — I'll loop in procurement and legal for final sign-off once Olivia confirms the invoice baseline. Planning to send to customer tomorrow morning unless anybody flags changes.

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks team. If Olivia can drop the sample credit calc table into the doc, I'll finalize.
